## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what the user experiences before and after this change.

## Scope and boundaries

List the affected roles, services and any permission or recovery implications.

## Validation

State the checks performed, results and meaningful limits. Link real Linux
acceptance evidence for changes to privileged service integrations. Never add
credentials, live customer records or private deployment logs.

## Documentation

Update feature status, installation/upgrade/recovery guidance and the changelog
where the behavior changes.
